body:
:robot: :warning: :robot:

A newer stable release of `zizmor` is available on PyPI.

This PR refreshes the version groups in `support/pyproject.toml`,
including `zizmor-latest` for the default version, and their
hash-pinned requirements under `support/locks/`.

Please review manually before merging.

Cross-reference: <https://pypi.org/project/zizmor/>

comments.body: Hmm, this is kind of what I was afraid of with https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/pull/2425 -- older Ubuntu runners have random EOL Python versions on them, which screws with the bootstrapping here.

(For posterity, this broke because we bumped the Python version to 3.11 in zizmor's packaging metadata, but older GitHub Ubuntu runners had 3.10. The fix in #174 was to force a specific Python version during `pip download`, which is fine since this is all binaries under the hood anyways.)

CC @shaanmajid for viz

title: Sync zizmor versions
